decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (RB_105, 9912/L, Site Location Plan, Letter from Indigo Planning dated 07 August 2014 Received: 12 August 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times 06:30 - 21:00 Monday to Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for a Pilates studio and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - No music shall be played on the premises in such a way as to be audible within the adjoining premises or on the adjoining highway.
description: Change of use from existing office (B1a use) to proposed Pilates Studio (D2 use)
